_comment: Fixed points in your monthly money cycle — rent day, card due date, payday,
a subscription that always lands on the 14th. They are NOT transactions:
nothing here touches a balance or a total. They are day markers on the
Calendar view, so the shape of the month is visible before the rows arrive.
Edit this file (or ask your AI to), then re-run: python3 init_db.py
day    1-31, the day of every month the marker sits on
label  short text shown inside the calendar cell
detail one line spelled out in the legend under the calendar
tone   'due'  = money must leave on this day (red)
The two below are examples. Replace them with your own.

markers.label: Recurring expense
markers.detail: Recurring expense. Ask your AI to add or change this.

markers.label: Payday
markers.detail: Money arrives. Ask your AI to add or change this.
